STEP 1 - Vessel type: shallow-to-medium bowl (white, curved inner wall visible on all sides, food sits near the rim).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: a salad/serving bowl is typically 20-25 cm; this looks like a medium salad bowl, so about 22 cm.
b) Reference: the dark berries/olives are about 2.2 cm. Across the bowl's inner width there are roughly 9-10 olive lengths, giving about 20-22 cm.
Reconciled width: 21 cm.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Spinach (raw leafy greens): the base covers most of the bowl's inner surface, roughly 70% of a 21 cm bowl. Bowl capacity = 0.2 x 21^3 / 1000 ≈ 1.85 L (shallow bowl). Leaves are loose and cover the base, about 2 cm deep on average. Footprint ≈ 0.7 x 346 cm² ≈ 242 cm². Volume ≈ 242 x 2 ≈ 485 ml x 0.15 ≈ 73 g.
- Kalamata-style olives: visible count ~22, plus ~8 hidden beneath, so ~30 olives x 4 g ≈ 120 g.
- Shredded carrot: a mound covering about 20% of the bowl, ~3 cm thick at the centre, averages about 1.5 cm. Footprint ≈ 0.2 x 346 ≈ 69 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 104 ml x 0.6 ≈ 62 g.
- Dressing: not clearly visible, so no separate item is added.

Total ≈ 73 + 120 + 62 = 255 g.

kcal per 100 g:
- Raw spinach: 23
- Olives (cured, brined): 145
- Raw carrot: 41
